entities.summary: HyperCam is a crippleware screencasting program made and created by Hyperionics and Solveig Multimedia. It captures the action from a Microsoft Windows screen and saves it to an AVI or WMV or ASF movie file. HyperCam will also record all sound output, and sound from the system microphone can also be recorded.
